d:
A strange, amorphous entity composed of undulating, gelatinous mass in shades of translucent lime green. The form is irregular and shifting, with several small, blinking eyes of vivid amber scattered across the surface. The body lacks a traditional skeletal structure, appearing as a quivering heap of slime. The tail is a tapered, dripping extension of translucent lime green.
BODY COLOR: translucent lime green
